title: Heading that scales with the screen
summary: font-size: clamp() grows a heading smoothly between a minimum and a maximum.
explanation: clamp(min, preferred, max) picks the preferred value but never goes below min or above max. With a preferred value in vw (percent of the viewport width), the heading grows smoothly as the screen gets wider, with no media queries.
The rem bounds keep it readable on phones and stop it getting absurd on wide monitors. Mixing in rem (1rem + 3vw) also means the size still responds when the reader zooms.
Drag the preview width or switch between 375 and 1440 to watch it scale.
tryThis: Switch the preview between 375 and 1440: the heading grows, the paragraph does not.
Change the max to 6rem and widen the preview.
Replace the clamp with a fixed 3rem: it is now too big on a phone.

children.text: The heading scales with the viewport. This paragraph stays the same size.
